title: Autonomy Register — Section C: Delegation Chain Fields
description: Section C of the Autonomy Register entry, as specified in STD-EDS-007.

delegation_chain_role.description: Values: Standalone │ Orchestrator │ Sub-Agent │ Orchestrator-Sub-Agent. Default: Standalone. Must be reviewed at each ADAE recalculation. (Source of truth: CAIO)

delegation_chain_depth.description: [Mandatory for Orchestrator] Values: 0 (Standalone or Sub-Agent only), 1 (orchestrator directs sub-agents), 2 (two-layer chain), 3 (three or more layers). Null where delegation_chain_role = Standalone or Sub-Agent. Must match the depth loading applied in the adae_score calculation. (Source of truth: CAIO)

registered_sub_agent_ids.description: [Mandatory for Orchestrator] Format: SYS-YYYY-NNN. Each listed ID must resolve to an Active Autonomy Register entry. Array must be updated within 5 business days of any change to the authorised sub-agent set. Null where delegation_chain_role = Standalone or Sub-Agent. (Source of truth: CAIO office)

registered_orchestrator_id.description: [Mandatory for Sub-Agent] Format: SYS-YYYY-NNN. Must resolve to an Active Autonomy Register entry with delegation_chain_role = Orchestrator or Orchestrator-Sub-Agent. Null where delegation_chain_role = Standalone or Orchestrator. (Source of truth: CAIO office)

chain_authority_ceiling.description: [Mandatory for Orchestrator] Currency value in AUD. Must not exceed the orchestrating system's individual mam_limit multiplied by the count of registered_sub_agent_ids at any point in time. Null where delegation_chain_role = Standalone or Sub-Agent. (Source of truth: CAIO)

last_chain_integrity_assessment.description: [Mandatory for Orchestrator] Must be within 12 months. Triggers non-compliance flag when overdue. Null where delegation_chain_role = Standalone or Sub-Agent. (Source of truth: CAIO)

next_chain_assessment_due.description: [Mandatory for Orchestrator — derived] Computed as last_chain_integrity_assessment + 12 months, or within 30 days of any change to registered_sub_agent_ids or delegation_chain_depth. Null where delegation_chain_role = Standalone or Sub-Agent. (Source of truth: CAIO office)
